_note: Three damage types (owner t98u). Armour ratings per type live in armors.json. Numbers are placeholders tuned to the history notes in docs/COMBAT_STANCES_MANEUVERS.md.

slashing.note: Cuts are devastating on bare skin and cloth (+2 damage where the zone's slashing armour is 2 or less) and bleed, but mail and plate stop them best.

piercing.note: Thrusts make narrow wounds (-1 damage) but armour rates lowest against them through mail rings and plate gaps; the half-sword and the beak use this.

blunt.note: Impact passes through armour as shock (armour rates lowest against it), causes 25% more pain, rarely bleeds; impact weapons are heavy and less versatile.

armor_piercing.weapons: all axes (one- and two-handed, thrown, no size distinction), halberd/poleaxe/bardiche/lochaber/bill and other axe- or spike-headed polearms, the lucerne hammer, war hammer, mace, morning star, flail, chekan, war pick. Never swords, daggers, spears or staffs.
armor_piercing.note: ONE mechanic (replaces the old percussive rule and impact armour-defeat). Each armour layer covering the hit zone protects `value` less (never below 0), whatever the damage type. A perk can add +1 (cap value+1); the Crater trick gives value+2 once per fight. On a hit that the armour absorbs, the armour loses durability_multiplier x the normal durability loss (armor_system ARMOR_WEAR_FRACTION). Tune `value` here only.
